The pastries and desserts were pretty mediocre. I tried the matcha tiramisu and didn’t think it lived up to the hype. That said, considering the relatively cheap prices, there’s not much to complain about in terms of value.

The drinks were also fairly generic and nothing particularly memorable. The drink presentation reminded me a lot of CHAGEE, although the actual packaging felt quite flimsy and cheap.

The place itself was nice and comfortable, and the service was good. Car parking felt quite limited when I visited.

Overall, it’s affordable and has a nice atmosphere, but the food and drinks weren’t good enough for me to understand the hype. Probably not somewhere I’d specifically come back for.
